JINXED_TWEAKS.Title: Jinxed Tweaks
JINXED_TWEAKS.LoadThrottle.Name: Media load throttle
JINXED_TWEAKS.LoadThrottle.Hint: Limits parallel map/media loads and serves media from play.jinx.gg only (skips the CDN) to avoid ISP anti-abuse blocks. Auto uses UK timezone detection.
JINXED_TWEAKS.LoadTrace.Name: Scene load trace users
JINXED_TWEAKS.LoadTrace.Hint: Comma-separated Foundry user names that get detailed scene-load breakpoint logging (console + GM socket relay). Empty disables. Add ?jinxLoadTrace=1 to force for yourself.
JINXED_TWEAKS.DmMapNotes.ToolHint: Drag empty map (with this tool) to draw an area. DM notes stay visible on the map for the GM on any tool. Click to select, drag to move, Delete to remove, right-click for Lock/Delete. Double-click to open notes. Hidden from all players including Trusted.
JINXED_TWEAKS.DmMapNotes.Title: DM Note
JINXED_TWEAKS.DmMapNotes.DragHint: Drag to draw an area for the DM note.
JINXED_TWEAKS.DmMapNotes.LockedSkipped: Locked DM notes were left unchanged.
JINXED_TWEAKS.DmMapNotes.ClearedLevel: Cleared {count} DM note(s) on the current level.
JINXED_TWEAKS.DmMapNotes.DeleteConfirm: Delete this DM map note? This cannot be undone.
TYPES.HINTS.RegionBehavior.jinxed-tweaks: When a Token enters the Region, save its elevation and set the configured elevation (clamped inside the Region's elevation range). Restore the saved elevation when it leaves.
JINXED_TWEAKS.RegionBehavior.TemporaryEl: Elevation applied while the Token is inside this Region. Automatically clamped so the Token stays inside the Region's elevation range (prevents enter/exit loops). Restored on exit.
JINXED_TWEAKS.LevelNightMaps.ThresholdHi: When scene darkness is at or above this value (0–1), levels and tiles with a night image switch to it. Same darkness signal as ambient light activation ranges (timekeeping or Day/Night tools).
JINXED_TWEAKS.LevelNightMaps.Hint: If set, this level’s background/foreground swaps automatically at night. Leave empty to keep the day map only.
JINXED_TWEAKS.LevelNightMaps.LevelThresh: Optional per-document override (0–1). Empty uses the world setting.
JINXED_TWEAKS.TileNightMaps.Hint: If set, this tile’s image swaps automatically at night. Leave empty to keep the day texture only.
JINXED_TWEAKS.TileRadialRadius.Label: Radial Occlusion Radius
JINXED_TWEAKS.TileRadialRadius.Hint: When Radial occlusion is enabled, this sets the minimum size of the transparent hole around tokens under this tile (grid units). Uses the larger of this value and each token’s Occlusion Radius (Token Config → Identity). Leave empty to use the token radius only.
JINXED_TWEAKS.OpenAI.ApiKeyHint: Your personal OpenAI API key (stored in this browser only). Used to polish imported Fandom wiki text in Campaign Codex.
JINXED_TWEAKS.OpenAI.ModelHint: Chat model for wiki text improvement. Default: gpt-5.6-luna.
JINXED_TWEAKS.OpenAI.ImproveOnImportHint: When enabled, imported Fandom wiki HTML is reorganized and polished by OpenAI — thin infobox fields are merged, campaign-episode sections are removed, and the result is shaped as an in-world codex reference.
JINXED_TWEAKS.OpenAI.ImproveWritingEmpty: The editor is empty — nothing to improve.
JINXED_TWEAKS.OpenAI.ImproveWritingNoCha: ChatGPT finished but made no substantive changes.
JINXED_TWEAKS.OpenAI.ImproveWritingDone: Draft updated in the editor — press Save to keep changes or close without saving to discard.
JINXED_TWEAKS.OpenAI.ImproveWritingSelec: Selected text updated in the editor — press Save to keep changes or close without saving to discard.
JINXED_TWEAKS.OpenAI.ProxyUrlHint: If direct OpenAI requests are blocked by CORS, set a server proxy base URL (for example https://your-server.example/openai). The proxy should forward POST /v1/chat/completions and accept apiKey in the JSON body.
JINXED_TWEAKS.OpenAI.MissingKey: OpenAI API key not configured. Add it in Jinxed Tweaks module settings.
JINXED_TWEAKS.OpenAI.CorsHint: OpenAI request was blocked (often CORS). Add an OpenAI proxy URL in Jinxed Tweaks settings or use the Foundry desktop app.
JINXED_TWEAKS.OpenAI.WikiContextHint: When improving imported wiki text, search the Fandom wiki for related articles (linked pages and search results) and pass short excerpts as background context. ChatGPT is instructed to keep the page focused on the main subject.
JINXED_TWEAKS.CodexAutoLink.EnabledHint: When enabled, names of existing Campaign Codex entries (people, locations, factions, quests, etc.) are linked automatically in Information and Notes text.
JINXED_TWEAKS.CodexAutoLink.MinNameLengt: Only link codex entry names at least this many characters long (reduces false positives on short names).
JINXED_TWEAKS.CodexProseMirror.RecoverFa: The editor failed to open cleanly. Click the edit button again.
JINXED_TWEAKS.CodexProseMirror.SaveFaile: Campaign Codex failed to save text: {message}
JINXED_TWEAKS.FandomWiki.DialogIntro: Import all wiki sections into {name}. Sections are detected automatically from the article.
JINXED_TWEAKS.FandomWiki.WikiBaseHint: The Fandom wiki host. Your last-used site is remembered for this browser session.
JINXED_TWEAKS.FandomWiki.ArticleHint: Paste a full article URL, a /wiki/ path, or just the page name.
JINXED_TWEAKS.FandomWiki.PreviewIdle: Enter an article to preview the resolved wiki page.
JINXED_TWEAKS.FandomWiki.UrlRequired: Enter a wiki article URL or page name.
JINXED_TWEAKS.FandomWiki.ImproveWithAiHi: Reorganize into a focused codex article: merge thin infobox fields, drop campaign-episode plot sections, polish prose.
JINXED_TWEAKS.FandomWiki.OpenAiUnavailab: Add an OpenAI API key in Jinxed Tweaks settings to enable ChatGPT polishing on import.
JINXED_TWEAKS.CodexSidebarDelete.Title: Delete Campaign Codex Entry
JINXED_TWEAKS.CodexSidebarDelete.Confirm: Delete {name}? This permanently removes the journal entry and cannot be undone.
JINXED_TWEAKS.CodexHubFolders.DeleteFold: Delete this folder? Entries inside will move back to the category root.
